outcome: A project can add and remove member roles, WorkItem reviewers, approvers, and watchers, and apply role, repository, CI, and environment WIP policies that block overloaded assignment
acceptance: a project can add a role to a team member and the change is audited
a project can remove a role from a team member and the change is audited
a WorkItem can add and remove reviewers, approvers, and watchers from the project roster
unknown roles or members from another project fail loud
role, repository, CI, and environment WIP policies block a new assignment when the limit is reached
humans and agents can use different WIP policies
the team capacity view shows overload warnings from those policies
customers cannot change the roster, roles, participants, or WIP policies
inScope: project WIP policies for role, repository, CI, environment, and member type
assumptions: project team members, member-level WIP, and assignment already exist
